'''Airborne mines''' were explosive weapons in use around the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. These [[Mine/Legends|mines]] were stationary until they acquired a target, usually a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]. The mines pursued the target until they exploded or the target went out of range, in which case the mine stopped. They were also capable of operating in space, and the space versions featured a built-in [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]]. The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] employed these mines during their invasion of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and used them to guard installations such as the [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] [[Comm 4]], a [[Trade Federation base|base]], and the [[Trade Federation Airbase]]. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] also employed these mines to guard the entrance of his [[Porso Hill|outpost]]. Many of these types of mines were destroyed by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]].

==Behind the scenes==
These mines appear in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''.
